sentences.text: 08/09/2025 Heard Mr. P Kataki, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. M P Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State respondent.
2. The matter was taken up for final disposal and the parties were heard at length in the matter.

3. On perusal of the evidence brought on record including the statement of the victim girl, i.e., PW1 under Section 164 Cr.P.C. as well as her deposition in the trial, this Court finds perversity in the conclusions drawn by the learned Trial Court vide the judgment, assailed in the present proceedings, with regard to the offence committed upon the victim girl, i.e., PW1, by the accused appellant.
4.

This Court has noticed that the deposition of the victim girl (PW1) brings on record, Page No.#
2/2 commission of sexual assault upon her by the accused appellant.

However, it is found that the learned Trial Court had rejected the said evidence of the PW1/victim by holding that the accused had not stated anything about penetration made inside her private organs by the accused.

Further,
the age of the prosecutrix, i.e., PW1 was declared by her as 15 years and the medical examination had also found that the victim girl was about 14 years and below 16 years.

The said evidence was not Md. Nur Siddique Ali vs State Of Assam on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163700542/
1 disputed by the accused/appellant herein.

sentences.text: However, the learned Trial Court without recording any reason for the said purpose, proceeded to consider the victim girl, i.e., PW1 as a major at the time of commission of the offence upon her by the accused appellant.

5. The above facts having been noticed, this Court had required that the learned counsel for the appellant as well as the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam, appearing in the matter for the State to make their submissions in the matter.

6. It was submitted at the bar that this Court now having found that the charge against the appellant under Sections 376 and 417 IPC would be required to be maintained basing on the materials available on record, it was submitted that the notices be issued in the matter to both the accused appellant as well as the informant/victim.

7. In view of the above position emanating in the matter, this Court hereby issues notice to both the accused/appellant, as well as the informant/victim, on the point as to why the accused/appellant shall also not be convicted under Section 376 IPC and Section 417 IPC.
8.

Registry is directed to issue notices upon the accused/appellant and the informant/victim through the jurisdictional District & Sessions Judge, as well as through the jurisdictional Superintendent of Police.
Said notice be issued within a period of 1 (one) week from today.
9. Registry to list this matter again on 14.10.2025 for further hearing.
